market_summary: 132 listings match the filters today, with a median asking price of 2 995 000 kr and 227 723 kr per ha. Two came in, a small farm in Hylte at 1 950 000 kr and a 1909 farm near Tidaholm town at 3 495 000 kr. Two left the market, both in Dalsland/Värmland (Spakebol in Åmål and Norra Skarbol Enebacken in Säffle), after 19 days on the radar. Karl Gustav Sonås 1 in Varberg was cut from 3 250 000 kr to 3 000 000 kr after about two months. The market is still slow, so there is room to negotiate, but neither newcomer clearly passes the low-maintenance bar yet.

entries.prepping_why: About 9 ha of fairly stone-free arable and pasture right by the yard, which is excellent for food and animals, but under 0.5 ha of forest, so firewood would have to be bought or planted. No well and no wood heating are mentioned, and a gårdshotell with a restaurant a short walk away means the place is neither secluded nor quiet. At 1.3 h from Göteborg it is easy to reach and the bygd is clearly alive.
entries.invest_why: At 188 224 kr per ha it sits below the 227 723 kr median, and 9 ha of good Halland arable land is worth roughly 1 to 2 MSEK alone, so the house comes cheap. The value is in arable land, not forest, which is steadier but grows more slowly than southern forest. Halland inland resells well and the low price keeps the buyer pool wide.
entries.rank_why: The cheapest solid farm in its band with real food land close to Göteborg, held back by almost no forest and no facts on the house.
entries.maintenance: Unknown: build year, facade, roof and windows are not stated; a 1.5-plan house with basement, ladugård, brygghus and garage means several outbuildings to maintain.
entries.recommendation: Ask the broker for build year, facade and roof material, window age, heating system and well details first, because the land and price are right but the house is a blank.

entries.prepping_why: 14.6 ha with arable, pasture, forest and horse paddocks gives food and some firewood, and the farm buildings offer storage and workshop space. No well or wood heating is mentioned, and the selling point is closeness to Tidaholm town, which is good for community but poor for seclusion and access control. 1.8 h from Göteborg is within range.
entries.invest_why: At 238 893 kr per ha it is slightly above the median, and the forest share is not stated, so the forest value cannot offset the price yet. Skaraborg is a less liquid market than Halland or the hinterland. A 1909 house with no renovation stated is a capex risk under the new mortgage rules.
entries.rank_why: Good land size for the money, but a 1909 timber-era house with no documented renovation and a near-town location put it below the cleaner candidates.
entries.maintenance: Built 1909, 105 m2, likely wooden facade; roof, windows, electrics and drainage need checking and probably work within ten years.
entries.recommendation: Ask the broker for the renovation history (roof, windows, electrics, drainage), facade material, heating and well first, and skip it if there is no documented total renovation.

entries.prepping_why: 4.5 ha of horse paddocks gives pasture but almost no forest for firewood, and no well or wood heating is mentioned. The high, elevated position is a plus and 1 h from Göteborg is the best reach on the list. The large ladugård with stall offers shelter and storage but no second dwelling.
entries.invest_why: At 666 667 kr per ha it costs nearly three times the median, so you are paying for the house and location, not land. The cut from 3 250 000 kr to 3 000 000 kr after 64 days on Hemnet shows the seller is flexible. Halland hästgårdar resell well, but the friskrivningsklausul shifts all hidden-defect risk to the buyer.
entries.rank_why: Closest to Göteborg, but small land, a 1939 house sold with a friskrivningsklausul and a high price per ha keep it near the bottom.
entries.maintenance: Built 1939, carefully renovated over the years but no documented total renovation; facade, roof and windows unstated, large ladugård to keep up.
entries.recommendation: Skip, because it fails the land and low-maintenance tests and the friskrivningsklausul puts every hidden defect on us, even after the price cut.
